basic_details.job_title: ICAR-IIMR Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: ICAR - Indian Institute of Maize Research (ICAR-IIMR), Ludhiana is filling 01 post of Young Professional-II under the "Institute Budget" project, with Dr. Bharat Bhushan, Senior Scientist, as PI. The engagement is contractual and co-terminus with the project/scheme, and the pay is Rs. 42,000/- (consolidated). Candidates need a Master's degree in Life Sciences, Biological Sciences or Agricultural Sciences or an equivalent post graduate degree. qualification.details: Master's degree in Life Sciences or Biological Sciences or Agricultural Sciences (relevant subjects eg. Biochemistry/Biotechnology), or an equivalent post graduate degree with a 4/5 years Bachelor's degree, from a recognised university or institution. Candidates who have a Post-Graduate degree in Basic Sciences with a 3 years Bachelor's degree must have either qualified NET/GATE or have two years of research experience in a research laboratory or research trial fields.

how_to_apply: The notice offers two ways to be interviewed: in person at the walk-in, or online after sending an application by email.
Fill in the application format printed with the notice ("Application for the Temporary Contractual Position ... at ICAR-IIMR") and paste a recent passport-size photograph on it.
In item 11 of the form, write the name of the position and the project name. A candidate can apply for one position only.
Attach proof of category (SC/ST/OBC/General), attested copies of certificates from 10th onwards and proof of experience (only experience of one year and above).

Give details of publications (only published research papers in journals with NAAS rating/Impact Factor), say whether you have a No Objection Certificate from your present employer, and sign the declaration.
For the walk-in, report at ICAR-IIMR, Ladhowal Campus, Ludhiana on 25.11.2026 at 11.00 AM with the documents listed below.
For an online interview, send the application along with supporting documents to [email protected] by 24.11.2026.
Bio-data with particulars of age, qualification, subjects taken, year of passing, marks obtained and address proof, with a photograph pasted on the top right side of the application/bio-data.
Original certificates and their attested copies.
Experience certificate in original, if any.
NOC of the present employer, for persons already employed.
Candidates will not be permitted to appear in the interview without the original certificates of their educational qualifications.
important_instructions: Any change in the walk-in interview date will only be notified on the institute website https://iimr.res.in. The notice advises candidates to visit the website before attending the interview. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature. A candidate with a near or distant relative employed in ICAR/IIMR must declare the relative's name, designation, nature of duties and relationship in writing. If any information in the application is found false or incorrect, the candidature or appointment will be cancelled without notice, as per the declaration in the form.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-IIMR
content_sections.text: ICAR - Indian Institute of Maize Research is an ICAR institute located at Village Chahar, Ladhowal, Ludhiana, Punjab - 141008. The Young Professional-II post is funded from the Institute Budget and works under Dr. Bharat Bhushan, Senior Scientist, ICAR-IIMR, Ludhiana.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's degree in Life Sciences or Biological Sciences or Agricultural Sciences (relevant subjects eg. Biochemistry/Biotechnology), or an equivalent post graduate degree with a 4/5 years Bachelor's degree, from a recognised university or institution. Candidates who have a Post-Graduate degree in Basic Sciences with a 3 years Bachelor's degree must have either qualified NET/GATE or have two years of research experience in a research laboratory or research trial fields. Working experience in a Biochemistry Laboratory with HPLC/GLC and other ultra-modern equipments. The age limit for Young Professional-II is a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 45 years. The application form asks for the age as on the closing date for receipt of applications. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Young Professional-II gets Rs. 42,000/- per month as a consolidated amount. The notice does not mention any other allowance. The post is a purely time-bound, non-regular, temporary/contractual engagement and is co-terminus with the concerned project. The selected candidate will have no right whatsoever to absorption or regularization at ICAR-IIMR, Ludhiana or any other ICAR Institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-IIMR Young Professional-II
content_sections.text: The notice offers two ways to be interviewed: in person at the walk-in, or online after sending an application by email. Fill in the application format printed with the notice ("Application for the Temporary Contractual Position ... at ICAR-IIMR") and paste a recent passport-size photograph on it. In item 11 of the form, write the name of the position and the project name. A candidate can apply for one position only. Attach proof of category (SC/ST/OBC/General), attested copies of certificates from 10th onwards and proof of experience (only experience of one year and above). Give details of publications (only published research papers in journals with NAAS rating/Impact Factor), say whether you have a No Objection Certificate from your present employer, and sign the declaration. For the walk-in, report at ICAR-IIMR, Ladhowal Campus, Ludhiana on 25.11.2026 at 11.00 AM with the documents listed below. For an online interview, send the application along with supporting documents to [email protected] by 24.11.2026. Bio-data with particulars of age, qualification, subjects taken, year of passing, marks obtained and address proof, with a photograph pasted on the top right side of the application/bio-data. Original certificates and their attested copies. Relevant publications (if any). Experience certificate in original, if any. NOC of the present employer, for persons already employed. Candidates will not be permitted to appear in the interview without the original certificates of their educational qualifications.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates appear before the Selection Committee for a walk-in interview at ICAR-IIMR, Ladhowal Campus, Ludhiana on 25.11.2026 at 11.00 AM, or attend the interview online. A written test may be conducted before the oral interview for the post.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Any change in the walk-in interview date will only be notified on the institute website https://iimr.res.in . The notice advises candidates to visit the website before attending the interview. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature. A candidate with a near or distant relative employed in ICAR/IIMR must declare the relative's name, designation, nature of duties and relationship in writing. If any information in the application is found false or incorrect, the candidature or appointment will be cancelled without notice, as per the declaration in the form.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in ICAR-IIMR Young Professional-II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Young Professional-II under the "Institute Budget" project at ICAR-IIMR, Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q2. When is the ICAR-IIMR Young Professional-II walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in/online interview is on 25 November 2026 at 11.00 AM at ICAR-IIMR, Ladhowal Campus, Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the online interview?
faq.answer: Candidates who want to attend online must send their application with supporting documents to [email protected] by 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for ICAR-IIMR Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Life Sciences, Biological Sciences or Agricultural Sciences (eg. Biochemistry/Biotechnology), or an equivalent post graduate degree with a 4/5 years Bachelor's degree. A PG in Basic Sciences with a 3 years Bachelor's degree also needs NET/GATE or two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the post?
faq.answer: The age limit is a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of ICAR-IIMR Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 42,000/- (consolidated).

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are interviewed by the Selection Committee, walk-in or online, and a written test may be conducted before the oral interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the ICAR-IIMR Young Professional-II post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a purely time-bound, non-regular, temporary/contractual engagement co-terminus with the project, with no right to absorption or regularization.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. Persons already employed should bring an NOC from their present employer when they attend the interview.
